authority.note: Fluid owns fluid-domain semantics and formulations (state variables, properties, pressure gradients, fluxes, boundary/initial conditions, governing equations, discretization terms). Scalar/approx discipline consumed from mncs-numerics, never duplicated. FVM semantics are not forced into mncs-fem (untouched sibling). Variable-coefficient/sparse generic solving is open pressure P-FLUID-SOLVER: only its own uniform system is solved natively. Persists nothing, schedules nothing.
